It peaks (1.0-1.5 of max) only when such a token sits at a junction: right after a comma, colon or full stop, right after an opening brace in code (the newline that opens an indented block), or right after the verb or stem it completes ('shave off', 'missing out', 'dr|ab'); ordinary nouns, main verbs, names, physical adjectives (red, big, cold) and pure determiners/pronouns (the, a, we, it) leave it at zero.
